attempts_per_start: development and bounded same-episode retries; all retained
success: whole bottle lowest point > table + .02m, hand contact > .2N, object table force < .1N, pelvis > .45m, continuous final hold >=3s; opposed thumb/finger contact at end
contact_quality: separate: any monitored hand/forearm table contact > .05N; abort on latched .5N alert
author: GPT/Codex session reviews images and privileged/proprioceptive feedback at checkpoints; automated bounded supervisor between reviews; no external GPT API
controller: SONIC V2 ONNX walking; 3s reference handoff +1s standing; actual-state right-arm IK and bounded gravity compensation, SONIC other joints; GRAIL residual zero throughout.
formal_strategy: Two guarded spatial goals; C2 timing, live actual-state arm IK, SONIC balance and walking, bounded retry. First two formal runs revised high-level config during walking before any arm action; full revision logged.
retry_stress_definition: First grasp target intentionally shifted +8cm X, then automatic supported-bottle reopen/retreat/regrasp using current state. Not part of nominal five-start success rate.
interruption_policy: Original interrupted run remains non-success in original 5-run denominator. Identical-parameter repeat separately reported; never substitutes original outcome.
